Samsung Bespoke AI Fridge

"What if you could feel the AI without owning it?"

Bespoke AI Family Hub · Stitch + Nano-Visit Reaction

Block 1 · Creative Intent

Why Offline Visits, Not Product Seeding

Refrigerators can't be shipped to nano creators the way skincare or small appliances can. So instead of seeding the product, we seed the experience — guiding creators to Samsung's existing offline showroom (Samsung 837, NYC and equivalent Bespoke Home spaces) and letting them film honest, in-the-moment reactions to the AI features.

Tech mega/macro creators already get the seeded fridge and produce tutorial-style demos. Nano creators don't get the unit — but they can visit, react, and stitch the macro's tutorial themselves. That's the diffusion play.

The goal isn't a polished spec demo. It's the moment a friend turns to camera and says "wait this thing actually knows what's inside?" — that's the cognition that scales.

Core USPs This Catalog Targets

01
AI Vision Inside
The fridge knows what's inside without opening the door. Internal camera + AI recognition surfaced on the Family Hub LCD.
02
AI Recipe Recommendation
"Don't know what to cook?" — the fridge suggests recipes from what's actually inside. Tap → recipe → step-by-step.
03
SmartThings Ecosystem & Auto-Reorder
The fridge notices stock dropping and ties into SmartThings → grocery reorder, status alerts, full dashboard control.

Block 2 · Angle Catalog
Angle 01 · AI Vision Inside

"What's Inside? I Already Know."

The flex moment — creator bets a friend they can name everything in the fridge without opening the door. Family Hub LCD does the work.

Hero Stitch · @joslynkramer — Restock My Fridge
Hook
Scene
"Bet you can't tell me what's in that fridge."
On-Screen Line
"yo bro… i'll tell you EXACTLY what's in there. without opening it."
Direction
Stitch off Joslyn's restock clip — let her opening line play for 1–2s, then cut to creator turning to camera with a smirk, gesturing at the Bespoke AI Family Hub LCD behind them. Friend reacts skeptically off-camera or in frame. The hook isn't "look at this fridge" — it's a dare. Mid-close-up, handheld, casual showroom audio.
Caption Options
POV: walking into the Samsung showroom like 🚶‍♂️
bro thinks I'm bluffing 💀
no peek. no lie. just vibes.
Stitch source: @joslynkramer · sec ~4 (groceries set out)
Reaction
Scene
Inside view reveal — friend's "wait — what?!" beat.
On-Screen Line
creator: "oranges. half a cabbage. that mystery hot sauce you forgot about." / friend: 😦
Direction
Cut to the AI Vision Inside view on the Family Hub display (or the open-fridge interior). Creator points at items as they're called out. Don't cut the friend's reaction tight — let the awkward pause breathe for a beat. This is the cognition moment: the fridge knew.
Caption Options
she didn't believe me 😭
"how did it know about the cabbage" — her, traumatized
samsung is reading my fridge's mind at this point
Stitch source: @joslynkramer · sec ~28 (drawer reveal)
USP Punch
Scene
Family Hub LCD — AI Vision Inside, items labeled.
USP Tied
AI Vision Inside
Direction
Close-up on the Family Hub display showing the AI-recognized food inventory (left door / right door / drawer bins). Creator's finger tracing the items. Hold 2+ seconds on the screen. This is the proof shot — without it, the bit doesn't land.
Caption Options
it scanned the inside. no door opening. 🤯
my fridge can't even tell me when the milk expires
#BespokeAI #AIVisionInside #SamsungShowroom
Stitch source: @joslynkramer · sec ~18 (AI Vision Inside UI)
Angle 02 · AI Recipe Recommendation

"Don't Know What to Cook? Showroom It Is."

The deadpan-comedy angle. Creator solves "what's for dinner?" not by Googling — by visiting Samsung. Plays the absurdity straight.

Hero Stitch · @triggtube — Meatball Spaghetti Recipe Browse
Hook
Scene
"I literally have no idea what to make tonight."
On-Screen Line
"it's 6pm. fridge is full. brain is empty. you know where I'm going."
Direction
Open by stitching Trigg's "let me show you what we're cooking" beat for a second, then cut to creator on the sidewalk or in front of the Samsung 837 entrance, visibly defeated. Holding phone or tote bag. The hook plays the absurdity straight — they're treating the Samsung showroom like a recipe oracle. Talking head, daylight, ambient street audio.
Caption Options
when ur out of ideas you go to the source 🙏
samsung showroom for the dinner emergency
free idea. don't make me regret this.
Stitch source: @triggtube · sec ~13 (talking head)
Reaction
Scene
Inside — tapping through the Family Hub recipe screen.
On-Screen Line
"okay it's literally giving me a recipe based on what I told it I had at home."
Direction
Wide-to-medium shot of creator at the showroom's Family Hub display. Mirror Trigg's recipe-screen scrolling — tap a recipe, show the ingredient list populating. Keep tone curious but slightly amused — like they expected nothing and got something useful. Avoid sounding rehearsed.
Caption Options
it just… told me. ✨
no scrolling pinterest for 40 minutes today
apparently I'm having spaghetti & meatballs now
Stitch source: @triggtube · sec ~18 (SmartThings recipe screen)
USP Punch
Scene
Recipe screen close-up — recommendation in action.
USP Tied
AI Recipe Recommendation
Direction
Close-up on the recipe card — title, prep time, ingredient list visible. Creator's finger taps one. Hold 2+ seconds. Optional outro: creator walking out with a phone screenshot of the recipe.
Caption Options
tonight: courtesy of the samsung kitchen 🍳
why is my actual fridge so useless 💀
#BespokeAI #AIRecipe #SolvedBySamsung
Stitch source: @triggtube · sec ~22 (recipe detail)
Angle 03 · SmartThings & Auto-Reorder

"Stop Crying About Chicken. Just Buy This."

The friend-roast angle. A friend complains about running out of chicken breast — again. Creator calls them dumb and shows the SmartThings reorder/notification flow.

Hero Stitch · @SteveDoes — Bespoke AI Tech Deep-Dive
Hook
Scene
"I'm OUT of chicken breast AGAIN."
On-Screen Line
creator: "bro. this is the third time this month." / *fed up sigh*
Direction
Stitch Steve's intro line about the Bespoke AI's "knowing what's inside" capability for ~1.5s of context, then cut to creator visibly frustrated — phone in hand, possibly a text from a friend on screen ("WE'RE OUT OF CHICKEN AGAIN"). Creator looks at camera, half-laughs in defeat. Establish the everyday pain point in under 4 seconds.
Caption Options
girl. it's tuesday. how. 😩
my friend's grocery memory is a 404 page
if I get one more text about chicken I'm losing it
Stitch source: @SteveDoes · sec ~6 (intro framing the Bespoke AI)
Reaction
Scene
Showroom · "just get this and never text me again."
On-Screen Line
"see this? it notices. it tells you. it reorders. you do nothing. now stop texting me."
Direction
Creator at the Bespoke AI display, pointing or tapping the SmartThings ecosystem screen. Stitch off Steve's SmartThings dashboard walkthrough for proof. Deliver the line deadpan — half advice, half exasperation. Don't oversell the feature; the joke is that the friend is the broken part, not the fridge.
Caption Options
samsung trying to save my friendships 🙏
bro literally cannot remember chicken exists
this is now a public service announcement
Stitch source: @SteveDoes · sec ~141 (SmartThings dashboard)
USP Punch
Scene
SmartThings full-screen UI — alert / reorder flow.
USP Tied
SmartThings & Auto-Reorder
Direction
Close-up of the SmartThings UI on the Family Hub — fridge contents, alerts, reorder option. Tap to confirm. Hold 2+ seconds. Optional micro-graphic overlay (✅ Ordered) if the UI moment isn't dramatic enough on its own.
Caption Options
one tap. delivered tomorrow. crisis over. 📦
imagine your fridge texting the grocery store FOR you
#BespokeAI #SmartThings #AutoReorder
